pageCopy.hero_intro:
Hello 👋🏼

I’m Serazul Hoque, from Myanmar. I am studying Software Engineering at Istanbul Sabahattin Zaim University, in Istanbul, Turkey. I’ve always been curious about technology and how things work. As I’m a Rohingya, for us a good internet connection is rarely something you can count on, so studying higher education in my own country was restricted. Being able to study it here is something I’m really grateful for.

My goal is to become an AI engineer. I like building things. I’m still at the beginning, but I’m excited to learn, meet new people, and see where this goes.

Yours,
Serazul
pageCopy.contact_paragraph: Have a question, idea, or something you’d like to discuss with me? I’d love to get back to you...
pageCopy.about_paragraph_one: I’m pursuing software engineering because I want to turn ideas into things people can use. Right now, that means learning the foundations, asking questions, and connecting the small steps to a bigger goal.
pageCopy.about_paragraph_two: One idea keeps me curious: an AI people can talk to in Rohingya. It brings together my interest in technology and a language that matters to me. This is where I’m beginning.
